read.title: Holy Bible
read.oneLineSummary: The Old Testament prepares Christ, the New Testament reveals Christ; all Scripture tells how God creates, rescues, and finally renews all things in Christ.
read.body: Space for returning to the text—less noise, more room to dwell. If you stay on this path, it will join what you have already met in the verses on home.

read.plansLeadIntro: AskBible reading plans are not one-year checklists. We help you build a long-term, low-pressure rhythm for returning to Scripture—no catch-up, no “behind” messaging; you can always come back.
read.plansMethodLead: We offer two main paths for different seasons—not KPIs you must finish, but companions you can stay with or switch between.
read.plansMethodPath1Lead: Three independent loops—OT, NT, and Wisdom—one short segment per track each day. Finishing one track only advances that track. Light load for first habits or a sustainable, low-pressure return to Scripture.
read.plansMethodPath2Lead: Inspired by John MacArthur’s NT method—repeat each passage until it sinks in—we shaped a 52-stage ladder starting at 7 days per stage, with 14- and 28-day depths (~12 mo / 2 yr / 4 yr per round); one OT chapter daily in parallel.
read.plansLeadDefaultAfter: : a short OT, NT, and Wisdom segment each day on three independent tracks—gentle for first tries or lighter daily load.
read.plansLeadDeepBefore: If you already read steadily and want the NT to sink in, see
read.plansLeadDeepAfter: —52 stages, 7 / 14 / 28-day depth, about 12 months to 4 years per round.
read.plansLeadOther: You can also pick M'Cheyne, one-year tables, and other classic day-by-day plans below.

read.ntDeepRepeatPrinciple1: Path 2 · Effective deep study: 52 NT stages (usually 4–6 chapters), inspired by MacArthur’s “repeat until it sinks in”; “N passes” = N days per stage; one OT chapter daily.
read.ntDeepRepeatPrinciple2: No catch-up or “behind” messaging—just pick up where you are.
read.ntDeepRepeatPrinciple3: Start at 7 days/stage; optional 14 / 28-day depth—one round (52 stages) ≈ 12 mo / 2 yr / 4 yr.
read.ntDeepRepeatLighterPathLead: If you are new to daily reading or want low-pressure read-through, start with Path 1 (triple loop), then step up to Path 2.
read.ntDeepRepeatPaceIntro: Stay with each NT segment until it feels familiar; one OT chapter daily alongside. Based on MacArthur’s method, starting at 7 days per segment.
read.ntDeepRepeatPaceContinuousNote: Start from the activation day and read the same segment for {{days}} straight days; day {{nextDay}} moves to the next segment.
read.ntDeepRepeatPace7Summary: Read through the NT 7 times in about one year
read.ntDeepRepeatPace14Summary: Read through the NT 14 times in about two years
read.ntDeepRepeatPace28Summary: Read through the NT 28 times in about four years

read.ntDeepRepeatPaceOtNote: OT: one chapter daily in parallel; ~{{years}} yr for one full OT pass
read.tripleLoopTodaySummary: A short reading in Old Testament, New Testament, and Wisdom each; start with any track—progress stays separate.
read.tripleLoopPrinciple1: Tracks do not lock together; reading NT only advances the NT pointer.
read.tripleLoopPrinciple2: No catch-up days or “behind” messaging if you pause.
read.tripleLoopPrinciple3: After the last chapter of a track, that track restarts at the beginning.
read.tripleLoopDeepReadLead: Path 1 is for easy read-through. If you read steadily and want the NT to sink in, try Path 2—MacArthur-inspired deep study: 52 stages from 7 days/stage, optional 14 / 28-day depth (~12 mo to 4 yr per round).

triple-loop.title: Easy cycle reading plan
triple-loop.subtitle: AskBible Path 1 · Easy read-through
triple-loop.blurb: Three independent loops—one short segment per track daily. No catch-up, no “behind.” For first habits or a low-pressure return to Scripture.

nt-deep-repeat.title: Formal Scripture Study
nt-deep-repeat.subtitle: AskBible Path 2 · Effective deep study
nt-deep-repeat.blurb: MacArthur-inspired NT study, shaped into 52 stages (4–6 chapters each). From 7 days/stage—optional 14 / 28-day depth (~12 mo / 2 yr / 4 yr per round); one OT chapter daily. New? Start with Path 1.

mcheyne.title: M'Cheyne reading plan
mcheyne.subtitle: 麦琴读经表
mcheyne.blurb: Four short readings per day in a pattern linked to M'Cheyne: OT once, NT and Psalms about twice in a year. Steady daily time helps. Chinese title above is a short guide; English labels stay authoritative for the slice boundaries.

backtothebiblechronological.title: Back to the Bible Chronological
backtothebiblechronological.subtitle: 按历史时间线读通圣经
backtothebiblechronological.blurb: A one-year chronological sweep, often weaving Job and other blocks by storyline. Good if you like reading along historical time. Copyright notes in the source appear in English.

esvchroniclesandprophets.title: Chronicles and Prophets
esvchroniclesandprophets.subtitle: 历代志与先知书
esvchroniclesandprophets.blurb: A track centered on Chronicles and the prophetic books—helpful for history-and-oracle threads. “ESV” in the name is a source label only.

esveverydayinword.title: Every Day In the Word
esveverydayinword.subtitle: 每日读经（叙事分块）
esveverydayinword.blurb: Several readings per day, often large narrative slices including cross-chapter spans. English labels help you match the upstream table exactly.

esvgospelsandepistles.title: Gospel and Epistles
esvgospelsandepistles.subtitle: 福音与书信
esvgospelsandepistles.blurb: A New-Testament-focused year through Gospels and letters—pair it with an OT plan if you like balance.

esvliterarystudybible.title: ESV Literary Study Bible Plan
esvliterarystudybible.subtitle: 文学研读圣经计划
esvliterarystudybible.blurb: Multiple readings per day from a literary-study style table. The ESV wording in the title is historical; your on-site Bible text follows the translation you import.

esvpentateuchandhistoryofisrael.title: Pentateuch and History of Israel
esvpentateuchandhistoryofisrael.subtitle: 五经与以色列历史
esvpentateuchandhistoryofisrael.blurb: Starts in the Torah and walks through Israel’s historical books—good if you want covenant and narrative spine first.

esvpsalmsandwisdomliterature.title: Psalms and Wisdom Literature
esvpsalmsandwisdomliterature.subtitle: 诗篇与智慧文学
esvpsalmsandwisdomliterature.blurb: Emphasizes Psalms and wisdom books—useful alongside more narrative-heavy schedules.

esvthroughthebible.title: Through The Bible
esvthroughthebible.subtitle: 按书卷顺序通读圣经
esvthroughthebible.blurb: One OT and one NT reading most days (often two passages), finishing the Bible in a year. We list one daily OT+NT plan to avoid near-duplicates.

heartlightotandnt.title: Heartlight OT and NT
heartlightotandnt.subtitle: Heartlight：旧约与新约并进
heartlightotandnt.blurb: One OT and one NT reading each day for balanced coverage without overloading a single testament.

oneyearchronological.title: One Year Chronological
oneyearchronological.subtitle: 一年编年通读（多段并行）
oneyearchronological.blurb: Chronological ordering; some days stack several passages to mirror parallel events—feel free to spread a heavy day across more than one sitting.

explore.title: Explore
explore.lead: More little surprises are quietly on their way.
explore.body: This corner will slowly fill with small delights—nothing to rush, worth returning to unwrap bit by bit. They are still traveling; if you can wait a little, you will meet them here soon. Until then, the verses and light on Home, a track in Music, or a short hush in Relax can be surprises that walk with you.

passover.title: Passover
passover.summary: Remember God's deliverance, bringing His people out of bondage.
passover.fulfillment: Jesus, the Lamb, fulfills Passover and brings deliverance through His sacrifice.
passover.practice: Respond with gratitude and renewed trust in God's salvation.

unleavened-bread.title: Unleavened Bread
unleavened-bread.summary: Leave old leaven behind and walk in a set-apart life.
unleavened-bread.fulfillment: In Christ we put away old leaven and learn to walk in sincerity and truth.
unleavened-bread.practice: Turn from old patterns and pursue sincerity and holiness.

firstfruits.title: Firstfruits
firstfruits.summary: Offer the first and best to God, acknowledging Him as provider.
firstfruits.fulfillment: Christ's resurrection as firstfruits anchors our hope in new life.
firstfruits.practice: Give God your first attention, time, and strength.

weeks-pentecost.title: Weeks (Pentecost)
weeks-pentecost.summary: From firstfruits to harvest, God forms maturity and shared blessing.
weeks-pentecost.fulfillment: At Pentecost, the Spirit is poured out and the church is gathered for harvest.
weeks-pentecost.practice: Practice gratitude that overflows into generosity for others.

trumpets.title: Trumpets
trumpets.summary: A wake-up call to turn back to God and prepare to meet Him.
trumpets.fulfillment: It points to watchfulness and readiness for the Lord's coming.
trumpets.practice: Pause your pace and realign your life before God.

atonement.title: Day of Atonement
atonement.summary: A day of humility, repentance, cleansing, and reconciliation.
atonement.fulfillment: Christ, our High Priest, offers Himself once for all and secures eternal redemption.
atonement.practice: Confess, pray, and receive renewal under God's mercy.

tabernacles.title: Tabernacles
tabernacles.summary: Remember God's dwelling and care through the wilderness journey.
tabernacles.fulfillment: God dwells with us in Christ and will dwell with His people forever.
tabernacles.practice: Recount grace with joy and live daily in God's presence.

advent.title: Advent
advent.summary: The church prepares in hope and watchfulness for the coming of Christ.
advent.fulfillment: We remember Christ who came and wait for Christ who will come again.
advent.practice: Set aside a quiet moment daily to pray, "Lord, I am waiting for You."

christmas.title: Christmas
christmas.summary: We remember the birth of the Savior, God with us.
christmas.fulfillment: The Word became flesh and brought light and peace to the world.
christmas.practice: Share one word of Gospel hope with someone around you.

epiphany.title: Epiphany
epiphany.summary: Christ is revealed to the nations, not to one people only.
epiphany.fulfillment: In Christ, all peoples are invited into God's promise.
epiphany.practice: Pray for someone who does not yet know Christ.

ash-wednesday.title: Ash Wednesday
ash-wednesday.summary: The church begins Lent with repentance and humility.
ash-wednesday.fulfillment: At the cross we stop relying on ourselves and return to God's mercy.
ash-wednesday.practice: Confess honestly and surrender one burden to the Lord.

lent.title: Lent
lent.summary: A season of prayer, self-denial, and mercy as we follow Christ's path.
lent.fulfillment: We learn to carry the cross in love and obedience with Jesus.
lent.practice: Lay down one comfort and use that time for prayer and Scripture.

palm-sunday.title: Palm Sunday
palm-sunday.summary: We remember Jesus entering Jerusalem as the humble King.
palm-sunday.fulfillment: The promised King comes in peace and righteousness.
palm-sunday.practice: In worship, renew your confession that Christ is King over your life.

good-friday.title: Good Friday
good-friday.summary: We remember Christ's suffering and death on the cross.
good-friday.fulfillment: Jesus bears our sin and opens the way of reconciliation.
good-friday.practice: Spend time in silence at the cross and pray for reconciliation.

easter.title: Easter
easter.date: Sunday after the Paschal full moon
easter.summary: Christ is risen; death and darkness do not have the last word.
easter.fulfillment: The resurrection secures new life now and hope for eternity.
easter.practice: Offer a prayer of thanksgiving and share resurrection joy.

ascension.title: Ascension
ascension.summary: We remember Christ's exaltation and His continuing intercession.
ascension.fulfillment: The risen Lord reigns and sends His church in mission.
ascension.practice: Pray for your church and for Gospel witness in your city.

pentecost-church.title: Pentecost
pentecost-church.summary: We remember the coming of the Holy Spirit and the birth of witness.
pentecost-church.fulfillment: The Spirit still fills, guides, and empowers God's people today.
pentecost-church.practice: Ask the Holy Spirit to lead your words, choices, and service today.
